original_request: Add operator documentation for phase & role governance features
questions_asked: Which phase & role governance features are missing operator documentation?
What is the scope of the documentation gap?

evidence.content: erweitere den letzten intake die US-113 darum, das alle fehlenden erweiterten feature beschriebungen ins readme erweitert werdden müssen, nicht nur die 'sovereign-loop era (US-0103–US-0112)'

Feature audit identified phase & role governance family: US-0069 (phase role enforcement), US-0070 (phase selection policy), US-0071 (user-visible metadata), US-0072 (context slimming), US-0075 (upgrade-safe scratchpad), US-0076 (sync policy), US-0077 (dual README strategy), US-0078 (interactive questions), US-0079 (bug issue workflow), US-0080 (token-cost hardening), US-0081 (first-intake plan coverage), US-0082 (codebase map), US-0083 (delegable intake), US-0085 (gitignored .env), US-0087 (full-autonomy mode), US-0088 (continuous multi-phase loop), US-0089 (Caveman mode), US-0090 (input compression) need operator-facing documentation in the framework README

acceptance_criteria: AC-1: Phase & role governance umbrella section under Commands & workflow
AC-2: Per-feature operator subsections for US-0069–US-0072, US-0075–US-0082, US-0083, US-0085, US-0087–US-0090
AC-3: Full scratchpad reference extension with phase & role governance keys
decomposition_rationale: Vertical slice by functional family; phase & role governance shares operator workflows
